name: ai4bcm-guidance
description: The AI4BCM guidance and its ten skills, for AI use in business continuity management. /ask-ai4bcm names the skill, prompt and maturity level for your task; nine more each do one job, from preparing a BIA interview to checking a plan against the BIA. Every skill starts only when you type its name and writes nothing.

interface.shortDescription: Ten BCM skills and the router that names the right one
interface.longDescription: The AI4BCM guidance units and ten skills for business continuity work: /ask-ai4bcm names the skill, prompt, maturity level and gate for a task, and nine more each do one job, such as drafting a BIA interview guide or listing where a plan departs from the BIA. Each starts only when you type its name, returns a draft for a named reviewer, and writes nothing.
